title: When Routine Operations Break Architectural Pattern Relationships in LLM Agent Harnesses
abstract: arXiv:2611.09088v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agent harnesses distribute tool mediation, state management and safety guardrails across native services, independently written plugins and configuration. Routine operations can change the runtime order or retained state that architectural pattern relationships require, without any code change. We study five relationships associated with the Guardrail Enforcement Point, Autonomy Controller and Blackboard patterns across five released harnesses, analysing a main sample of fourteen independently written plugins. Using PatternOps, our assessment procedure, we trace requirements from pattern descriptions, provider documentation and deployment profiles to the providers that realise them and the records that decide them. We then compare alternative allocations under supported operations. Such operations broke relationships silently: after a plugin was reapplied or an allow rule saved, policy stopped evaluating edits while every plugin stay

translated_title: 当常规操作破坏LLM代理框架中的架构模式关系时
translated_abstract: LLM代理框架将工具中介、状态管理和安全防护机制分布在原生服务、独立编写的插件和配置之中。常规运维操作可以在不更改任何代码的情况下，改变架构模式关系所需的运行时顺序或保留状态。我们研究了五个已发布框架中与防护执行点、自主控制器和黑板模式相关的五种关系，并分析了包含十四个独立编写插件的主要样本。借助PatternOps——我们的评估程序——我们将来自模式描述、提供商文档和部署配置的需求，追溯到实现这些需求的提供方以及决定这些需求的记录，然后在受支持的操作下比较不同的分配方案。这类操作会悄然破坏模式关系：在重新应用插件或保存允许规则之后，策略停止对编辑进行评估，而所有插件仍然保持原状（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出PatternOps评估程序，揭示LLM代理框架中的常规运维操作（如重新应用插件、保存允许规则）无需任何代码更改即可悄然破坏防护执行点、自主控制器和黑板等架构模式关系，导致安全防护机制静默失效。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PatternOps, an assessment procedure revealing that routine operations—such as reapplying plugins or saving allow rules—can silently break architectural pattern relationships (Guardrail Enforcement Point, Autonomy Controller, Blackboard) in LLM agent harnesses without any code change, causing guardrails to fail silently.
